notes: sharded_slab::Slab is a concurrent slab, used from one thread with its default constructor. get returns a guard that is dereferenced. live counts the keys the adapter holds, not a length read from the slab.
details: sharded_slab::Slab is a concurrent slab; used from one thread with its default constructor. get returns a guard that is dereferenced for the value. live is the number of keys the adapter holds, not a length read from the slab.
